name: list_books
title: List books
description: Lists the books in the writer's Inkling library, newest first, with each one's id, title, author, format, number of chapters and where the writer is in it.

name: read_book
title: Read a book
description: Without a chapter, gives a book's contents: its chapters, numbered from 0. With a chapter, gives that chapter's text as Markdown.

name: search_library
title: Search the library
description: Finds text in the library's books, ignoring case. Each hit gives the book, the chapter and the passage around it.

name: read_draft
title: Read the draft
description: Gives the document the writer had open last, as the Markdown they are writing.

name: list_documents
title: List documents
description: Lists the writer's documents, the one changed last first, with each one's id, title and when it last changed.

name: read_document
title: Read a document
description: Gives one of the writer's documents as Markdown.

name: list_highlights
title: List highlights
description: Lists the passages the writer highlighted while reading, in reading order: for one book, or with no book_id for every book. Each gives the book, the chapter (from 0), where the passage starts and ends in that chapter's Markdown as read_book gives it, in bytes, its words, and when it was made.

book_id.description: Only this book's highlights. The id list_books gives.
